rules.title: ALLOWED_HOSTS allows every host
rules.why: A wildcard ALLOWED_HOSTS disables host header validation (cache poisoning, password reset poisoning).

rules.title: View exempt from CSRF protection
rules.why: csrf_exempt disables CSRF checks for the view.
rules.fix: Remove it, or authenticate the caller by token instead of cookie.

rules.title: Session or CSRF cookie not Secure
rules.why: *_COOKIE_SECURE = False sends the cookie over HTTP.
rules.fix: Set it to True in production.
